agent.name: ChatGPT deep research
does: Researches companies across many web sources
Writes cited reports on markets and competitors
Pulls together funding news and leadership info
Exports findings into docs or spreadsheets

whatYouLose: A structured, filterable database of funding rounds
Bulk exports and alerts on company changes
Confidence that numbers are verified, not inferred from the web
notes: Deep research is good for one-off company and market briefs. For screening thousands of companies by funding stage, a real database still wins.
